DE10Y.vintage: repository-provided historical values; real-time vintages not supplied

timing_policy.EUR_USD: one source-observation lag, then European reindex and forward-fill
timing_policy.VIX: one U.S. source-observation lag, then European reindex and forward-fill
timing_policy.SP500: one U.S. source-observation lag, then European reindex and forward-fill
timing_policy.DE10Y: repository CSV only; one monthly-period lag; month M usable from first day of M+1 Europe/Berlin local time; backward as-of/forward-fill on European dates; initial missing values never backfilled
timing_policy.US_inputs: conservative source-date New York day-end availability
timing_policy.EURUSD_availability: Yahoo daily label is not an audited intraday publication timestamp. Bound availability at source-date New York day-end after one source-observation lag, and use only rows preceding target date; no same-day FX close is assumed available.
